Welcome to Samaguri College
Samaguri College, a newly provincialized college included under 2 (F) 12B of UGC Act in the year 2013, is situated in a green and serene atmosphere on the north bank of river Kolong. It is a few steps ahead from the newly constructed RCC bridge over Kolong connecting No. 37 NH. Buses, tempos, and other shuttle vans are available to reach the college at any time from Nagaon Town & from Samaguri Township.......
